description: Static implementation properties for a pump.

AtmosphericPressure.description: Mean absolute pressure of the atmosphere measured at the place of installation (2.1.1.3) of the pump
AtmosphericPressure.title: AtmosphericPressure

Density.description: Volumetric mass at a stated temperature
Density.title: Density

DynamicViscosity.description: Ratio of the shear stress to the shear velocity acting in a liquid subjected to a plane shear motion
DynamicViscosity.title: DynamicViscosity

HeightOfTheInletManometer.description: Height of the zero or center position of the inlet manometer, or other point as defined by the manometer calibration
HeightOfTheInletManometer.title: HeightOfTheInletManometer

HeightOfTheNpshDatumPlane.description: Difference between the NPSH datum plane and the reference plane
HeightOfTheNpshDatumPlane.title: HeightOfTheNpshDatumPlane

HeightOfTheOutletManometer.description: Height of the zero or center position of the outlet manometer, or other point as defined by the manometer calibration
HeightOfTheOutletManometer.title: HeightOfTheOutletManometer

HydraulicEfficiency.description: Proportion of pump available power input, Pa, which is delivered as pump power output, Pu, after satisfying the losses resulting from friction due to the relative motion of internal surfaces and internal leakage
HydraulicEfficiency.title: HydraulicEfficiency

InstallationTotalHead.description: Difference between the total head at the outlet side of the installation and the total head at the inlet side of the installation
InstallationTotalHead.title: InstallationTotalHead

KinematicViscosity.description: Ratio of the dynamic viscosity to the density of the pumped liquid
KinematicViscosity.title: KinematicViscosity

MaximumAllowableFlow.description: Greatest rate of flow that the pump can be expected to deliver continuously without risk of internal damage when operated at the rated speed and on the liquid for which it was supplied
MaximumAllowableFlow.title: MaximumAllowableFlow

MaximumDynamicSealingPressure.description: Highest pressure expected at the shaft seals during any specified operating condition and during startup and shutdown
MaximumDynamicSealingPressure.title: MaximumDynamicSealingPressure

MechanicalEfficiency.description: Proportion of the pump power input, P, available after satisfying the mechanical power losses, PJ,ab, at given operating conditions
MechanicalEfficiency.title: MechanicalEfficiency

MinimumAllowableFlow.description: Smallest rate of flow that the pump can be expected to deliver continuously without risk of internal damage when operated at the rated speed and on the liquid for which it was supplied
MinimumAllowableFlow.title: MinimumAllowableFlow

MinimumAllowableStableFlow.description: Lowest flow at which the pump can operate without exceeding the noise and vibration limits imposed in the order
MinimumAllowableStableFlow.title: MinimumAllowableStableFlow

NetPositiveSuctionHeadAvailable.description: Minimum NPSH available at the inlet area of the pump as determined by the conditions of the installation for a specified rate of flow
NetPositiveSuctionHeadAvailable.title: NetPositiveSuctionHeadAvailable

OverallEfficiency.description: Proportion of the driver power input, Pmot, delivered as pump power output, Pu
OverallEfficiency.title: OverallEfficiency

PumpBestEfficiency.description: Greatest value of pump efficiency obtained at given operating conditions
PumpBestEfficiency.title: PumpBestEfficiency

PumpEfficiency.description: Proportion of the pump power input, P, delivered as pump power output, Pu, at given operating conditions
PumpEfficiency.title: PumpEfficiency

PumpMechanicalPowerLosses.description: Power absorbed by friction in bearings and shaft seal at given operating conditions of the pump
PumpMechanicalPowerLosses.title: PumpMechanicalPowerLosses

PumpRatedPowerInput.description: Power required by the pump at the rated conditions
PumpRatedPowerInput.title: PumpRatedPowerInput

PumpTotalHead.description: Difference between the total head at the outlet side of the pump and the total head at the inlet side of the pump
PumpTotalHead.title: PumpTotalHead

RatedDifferentialPressure.description: Differential pressure for the operating conditions at the guarantee point
RatedDifferentialPressure.title: RatedDifferentialPressure

RatedFlow.description: Rate of flow at the guarantee point
RatedFlow.title: RatedFlow

RatedMeanVelocityAtInletAreaOfTheInstall.description: Rated flow at the inlet area of the installation divided by the inlet area of the installation
RatedMeanVelocityAtInletAreaOfTheInstall.title: RatedMeanVelocityAtInletAreaOfTheInstallation

RatedMeanVelocityAtOutletAreaOfTheInstal.description: Rated flow at the outlet area of the installation divided by the inlet area of the installation
RatedMeanVelocityAtOutletAreaOfTheInstal.title: RatedMeanVelocityAtOutletAreaOfTheInstallation

RatedSpeed.description: Number of revolutions of the pump in a given time required to meet the rated conditions
RatedSpeed.title: RatedSpeed

TotalHeadAtInletAreaOfTheInstallation.description: Head observed at inlet area of the installation, corresponding to the sum of the height, pressure head and velocity head
TotalHeadAtInletAreaOfTheInstallation.title: TotalHeadAtInletAreaOfTheInstallation

TotalHeadAtOutletAreaOfTheInstallation.description: Head observed at outlet area of the installation, corresponding to the sum of the height, pressure head and velocity head
TotalHeadAtOutletAreaOfTheInstallation.title: TotalHeadAtOutletAreaOfTheInstallation

UsefulLife.description: Time interval from first use until the instant when a limiting state is reached
UsefulLife.title: UsefulLife

ValveSeatVelocity.description: Mean velocity of the flow through the valve seat at the specified operating conditions
ValveSeatVelocity.title: ValveSeatVelocity

ValveSpillVelocity.description: Mean velocity of the flow through the valve spill area
ValveSpillVelocity.title: ValveSpillVelocity

VaporPressureOfThePumpedLiquid.description: Absolute pressure at which the fluid vaporizes corresponding to the temperature of the liquid
VaporPressureOfThePumpedLiquid.title: VaporPressureOfThePumpedLiquid

VolumetricEfficiency.description: Ratio of the actual delivered volume at maximum pressure to the geometric displacement volume
VolumetricEfficiency.title: VolumetricEfficiency
